Grateful as I am to the good Being whose bounty has imparted to me this reasoning intellect, whatever it is, I hold myself proportionably indebted to him from whose enlightened understanding another ray of knowledge communicates to mine.

arxiv-2106-12302.title: 3D human tongue reconstruction from single “in-the-wild” images
arxiv-2106-12302.creator: Stylianos Ploumpis Stylianos Moschoglou Vasileios Triantafyllou, Stefanos Zafeiriou
arxiv-2106-12302.description: Abstract 3D face reconstruction from a single image is a task that has garnered increased interest in the Computer Vision community, especially due to its broad use in a number of applications such as realistic 3D avatar creation, pose invariant face recognition and face hallucination.

arxiv-2209-05768.title: REST: A java package for crafting realistic cosmic dust particles
arxiv-2209-05768.creator: Prithish Halder
arxiv-2209-05768.description: Abstract The overall understanding of cosmic dust particles is mainly inferred from the different Earth-based measurements of interplanetary dust particles and space missions such as Giotto, Stardust and Rosetta. The results from these measurements indicate presence of a wide variety of morphologically significant dust particles.

arxiv-2210-03845.title: Born this way: thin disc, thick disc, and isotropic spheroid formation in FIRE-2 Milky-Way-mass galaxy simulations 2022 Born this way: thin disc, thick disc, and isotropic spheroid formation in FIRE-2 Milky-Way-mass galaxy simulations – 13
arxiv-2210-03845.creator: Sijie Yu, James S. Bullock, Alexander B. Gurvich, Zachary Hafen, Jonathan Stern, Michael Boylan-Kolchin, Claude-André Faucher-Giguère, Andrew Wetzel, Philip F. Hopkins, Jorge Moreno
arxiv-2210-03845.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sijie Yu, James S. Bullock, Alexander B. Gurvich, Zachary Hafen, Jonathan Stern, Michael Boylan-Kolchin, Claude-André Faucher-Giguère, Andrew Wetzel, Philip F. Hopkins, Jorge Moreno. We investigate the formation of Milky-Way-mass galaxies using FIRE-2 Λ \Lambda CDM cosmological zoom-in simulations by studying the orbital evolution of stars formed in the main progenitor of the galaxy, from birth to the present day.

arxiv-2210-08923.title: RPoA: Redefined Proof of Activity
arxiv-2210-08923.creator: Sina Kamali, Shayan Shabihi, Mohammad Taha Fakharian, Alireza Arbabi, Pouriya Tajmehrabi, Mohammad Saadati, Behnam Bahrak
arxiv-2210-08923.description: Abstract The consensus protocol is the core of a blockchain system which guarantees its secure and stable operation. Proof of Activity (PoA) is a consensus protocol that tries to address some of the issues pertinent to the most widely used protocols, such as Proof of Stake (PoS) and Proof of Work (PoW).

arxiv-2301-11562.title: Arbitrariness and Social Prediction: The Confounding Role of Variance in Fair Classification
arxiv-2301-11562.creator: A. Feder Cooper, Katherine Lee, Madiha Zahrah Choksi, Solon Barocas, Christopher De Sa, James Grimmelmann, Jon Kleinberg, Siddhartha Sen, Baobao Zhang
arxiv-2301-11562.description: Abstract Variance in predictions across different trained models is a significant, under-explored source of error in fair binary classification. In practice, the variance on some data examples is so large that decisions can be effectively arbitrary . To investigate this problem, we take an experimental approach and make four overarching contributions.

arxiv-2305-17317.title: Live Programming for Finite Model Finders
arxiv-2305-17317.creator: Allison Sullivan
arxiv-2305-17317.description: Abstract Finite model finders give users the ability to specify properties of a system in mathematical logic and then automatically find concrete examples, called solutions, that satisfy the properties. These solutions are often viewed as a key benefit of model finders, as they create an exploratory environment for developers to engage with their model.

arxiv-2306-13978.title: Nuij Sequences for Gårding Hyperbolic Polynomials
arxiv-2306-13978.creator: Tristan Hasson
arxiv-2306-13978.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tristan Hasson. Hyperbolic polynomials were first introduced by Gårding in 1959 in [ 2 ] . The space of this type of polynomial was studied by Nuij and various results were given in [ 4 ] . Following the work of Kurdyka and Paunescu in [ 3 ] , this paper gives a result on hyperbolicity preserving operators on the space of polynomials. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C24 Main Result We begin by giving the definition of a hyperbolic polynomial to fix notation.

arxiv-2502-21054.title: HoloMine: A Synthetic Dataset for Buried Landmines Recognition using Microwave Holographic Imaging
arxiv-2502-21054.creator: Emanuele Vivoli, Lorenzo Capineri, and Marco Bertini
arxiv-2502-21054.description: Abstract The detection and removal of landmines is a complex and risky task that requires advanced remote sensing techniques to reduce the risk for the professionals involved in this task. In this paper, we propose a novel synthetic dataset for buried landmine detection to provide researchers with a valuable resource to observe, measure, locate, and address issues in landmine detection.

arxiv-2506-10241.title: Matter symmetries in supersymmetric standard models from non-invertible selection rules Preprint: EPHOU-25-009 KYUSHU-HET-325
arxiv-2506-10241.creator: Tatsuo Kobayashi 1, Hironobu Mita 1, Hajime Otsuka 2 , and, Riku Sakuma 1
arxiv-2506-10241.description: Abstract We discuss phenomenological implications of non-invertible selection rules in the framework of the supersymmetric standard model. We find that a remnant ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} symmetry of fusion algebras which holds at all-loop order plays the role of R R -parity, forbidding baryon and lepton violating operators.

arxiv-2510-00119.title: Automated Modeling with AAP-Imfit: Astrometry and Photometry via CASA AAP-imfit ( Amador-Portes et al. 2025 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , CASA ( McMullin et al. 2007 ; CASA Team et al. 2022 ) , Photutils (
arxiv-2510-00119.creator: Alfredo Amador-Portes, Eva Palafox, Víctor M. Patiño-Álvarez, Vahram Chavushyan, Andrei P. Lobanov, Sergio A. Dzib
arxiv-2510-00119.description: Abstract Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) provides the highest-resolution radio intensity maps, crucial for detailed studies of compact sources like active galactic nuclei (AGN) and their relativistic jets. Analyzing jet components in these maps traditionally involves manual Gaussian fitting, a time-consuming bottleneck for large datasets.

arxiv-2512-18246.title: Offline Behavioral Data Selection Conference: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.1; August 09–13, 2026; Jeju Island, Republic of Korea Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.1 (KDD ’26), August 09–13,
arxiv-2512-18246.creator: Shiye Lei, Zhihao Cheng, Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2512-18246.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shiye Lei, Zhihao Cheng, Dacheng Tao. Behavioral cloning is a widely adopted approach for offline policy learning from expert demonstrations. However, the large scale of offline behavioral datasets often results in computationally intensive training when used in downstream tasks. In this paper, we uncover the striking data saturation in offline behavioral data: policy performance rapidly saturates when trained on a small fraction of the dataset.

pmc-11500292.title: Pivotal Role of Surface Terminations in MXene Thermodynamic Stability
pmc-11500292.creator: Ervin Rems, Yong-Jie Hu, Yury Gogotsi, Robert Dominko
pmc-11500292.description: MXenes, i.e., two-dimensional transition metal carbides and nitrides, have been reported as promising materials for various applications, including energy storage, biomedicine, and electronics. The family of MXenes has proliferated, and the chemical space of synthesized MXenes has expanded to 13 transition metals and a dozen elements in surface terminations.

pmc-11653983.title: Evaluating the capacity of tertiary general hospitals in Beijing to prevent and treat respiratory infectious diseases: a delphi study
pmc-11653983.creator: Tong Hu, Mingyuan Liu, Xin Tian, Youqing Xin
pmc-11653983.description: BackgroundThe capacity of tertiary general hospitals to prevent and treat respiratory infectious diseases plays a key role in effectively containing the spread of major epidemics within hospitals and ensuring early treatment for patients. This, in turn, helps control the transmission of diseases at the societal level and safeguard public health.

pmc-12390559.title: Exploring the Molecular Functions and Immune Relevance of Macrophage-Associated Genes in Atherosclerosis
pmc-12390559.creator: Chenchen Yu, Haoran Wang, Huiting Xu, Peipei Kang, Jingjing Shao, Hui Zhang
pmc-12390559.description: Atherosclerosis is a common and significant cardiovascular condition that frequently goes undiagnosed by conventional diagnostic and treatment techniques until it reaches a more advanced stage. This challenge impedes the capacity to apply early detection and intervention measures. As a result, the creation of innovative and more accurate biomarkers is critically important.

pmc-12528639.title: Percutaneous transhepatic coil embolisation of a common hepatic artery aneurysm in vascular Ehlers–Danlos syndrome
pmc-12528639.creator: Oliver Chan, Hariesha Pathmaraj, Chris Grieco, Nadeem Shaida
pmc-12528639.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundVascular Ehlers–Danlos syndrome is a rare connective tissue disorder characterised by arterial fragility, predisposing patients to life-threatening vascular complications. Endovascular aneurysm management in these individuals poses significant challenges due to their delicate vasculature and limited surgical options.

pmc-12583557.title: Inhibition of BRD4 sensitizes NSCLC cells to osimertinib by suppressing APT1 and promoting MST1 palmitoylation
pmc-12583557.creator: Shaoqiang Wang, Yingying Zheng, Zhenyu Zhang, Lijie Qiu, Wolong Zhou, Heng Zhang
pmc-12583557.description: Osimertinib is widely used to treat non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) carrying epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutations. However, osimertinib resistance inevitably develops in almost all patients. In our study, osimertinib-resistant HCC827/OR and PC-9/OR cells were established from parental osimertinib-sensitive cells, and osimertinib (AZD9291) and NHWD870, a bromodomain and extra-terminal (BET) inhibitor, were used to treat cells and mice.

pmc-13293242.title: Diagnostic test accuracies of 4AT items are consistent across the range of baseline cognition: results from two prospective studies
pmc-13293242.creator: Patrick Hogan, Hannah Cheston, Ophelia Dunne, Dominic Gardner, Amy McWhirter, Mark James Rawle, Imogen Stoodley, Sarah Joanna Richardson, Louise M Allan, Alasdair M J MacLullich, Daniel H J Davis, Alex Tsui
pmc-13293242.description: BackgroundPresenting features of delirium can be difficult to distinguish from co-existing dementia phenomenology. While the 4 ‘A’s Test (4AT) is a well validated delirium screening tool across multiple patient populations and healthcare settings, how its diagnostic performance varies across different levels of baseline cognition is unclear.

pmc-13312794.title: Picroside III: novel multifunctional iridoid glycoside with promising antileukemic activity
pmc-13312794.creator: Chang Ha Park

pmc-13324535.title: Baseline assessment of sedimentary heavy metals and ecological risks in the high-siltation Gorai River, Bangladesh
pmc-13324535.creator: Sanjida Sultana Santa, Md Kamal Hossain, Mohammad Moniruzzaman, Arnob Ghosh, Rukaiya Hossain, M Belal Hossain, Md Harunor Rashid Khan, Takaomi Arai
pmc-13324535.description: The Gorai River, the largest distributary of the Ganges in Bangladesh, experiences high sedimentation and increasing anthropogenic pressure, raising concerns about heavy metal accumulation. This study examined the spatial distribution, pollution status, source apportionment, and ecological risks of 10 heavy metals in surface sediments collected from 22 sampling points along the Gorai River using a grab sampling method.

pmc-13361518.title: A Comprehensive Review of Antimicrobial Peptides and Smart Biomaterials in Chronic Wound Therapy: Overcoming Biofilms, Resistance, and Translational Barriers
pmc-13361518.creator: Laura Maghiar, Paula Bianca Maghiar, Ovidiu Pop, Anca Maria Mitran, Mihaela Mirela Muresan, Andreea-Adriana Neamțu, Dan Iliescu, Dan Brebu, Paul Andrei Tent, Florian Dorel Bodog, Valentin-Cristian Iovin, Cristina Dumitrescu, Andreea Maria Cristea, Alina Anton, Andrada Iftode, Florin Huț, Cristina-Ad
pmc-13361518.description: Chronic wounds represent a growing global healthcare burden driven by persistent inflammation, polymicrobial biofilm formation, impaired tissue regeneration, and increased antimicrobial resistance. This review examines the mechanistic interplay between chronic wound pathophysiology, biofilm persistence, and antimicrobial peptide (AMP)-based therapeutics, with particular emphasis on translational barriers and advanced biomaterial-enabled delivery strategies.

pmc-13371458.title: Linkages among foraging movements, prey provisioning, and reproduction in a central place foraging seabird
pmc-13371458.creator: Aliya Caldwell, Elizabeth Craig, Nathan T. Hermann, Nathan B. Furey
pmc-13371458.description: BackgroundA seabird’s ability to efficiently find prey directly affects reproduction, and seabird population declines are frequently linked to forage fish depletion. Reduced forage fish availability often limits seabird egg production and chick provisioning, but impacts to foraging movements remain largely unresolved, as does the effect of movement flexibility on provisioning and reproduction in conditions of reduced forage fish availability.

uslaw-usc-t10-s10154.title: 10 U.S.C. § 10154 — Retired Reserve
uslaw-usc-t10-s10154.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s10154.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Organization And Administration); Chapter 1005 (Elements Of Reserve Components). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Retired Reserve consists of the following Reserves: (1) Reserves who are or have been retired under section 7311, 8323, or 9311 of this title or under section 291 1 of title 14. (2) Reserves who have been transferred.
